G_LL.module:
FGReadout(
  (base): FrozenFCBase()
  (embed): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=776, out_features=128, bias=True)
    (1): GELU(approximate='none')
    (2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=True)
    (3): LayerNorm((128,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
  )
  (quality): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=True)
    (1): GELU(approximate='none')
    (2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=1, bias=True)
  )
  (membership): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=True)
    (1): GELU(approximate='none')
    (2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=1, bias=True)
  )
  (group_ff): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=256, bias=True)
    (1): GELU(approximate='none')

  )
  (group_norm): LayerNorm((128,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
)

MV_ATTN.module:
MVReadout(
  (input_projection): Linear(in_features=768, out_features=256, bias=True)
  (blocks): ModuleList(
    (0-3): 4 x AttentionBlock(
      (norm1): LayerNorm((256,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
      (attention): MultiheadAttention(
        (out_proj): NonDynamicallyQuantizableLinear(in_features=256, out_features=256, bias=True)
      )
      (norm2): LayerNorm((256,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
      (ff): Sequential(
        (0): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=1024, bias=True)
        (1): GELU(approximate='none')
        (2): Linear(in_features=1024, out_features=256, bias=True)
      )
    )
  )
  (query_norm): LayerNorm((256,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
  (token_norm): LayerNorm((256,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
  (pool): MultiheadAttention(
    (out_proj): NonDynamicallyQuantizableLinear(in_features=256, out_features=256, bias=True)
  )
  (output_norm): LayerNorm((256,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
  (output_projection): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=768, bias=True)
)

normalization: FC region and local_unit are parent-normalized; S/V/G/factorial pool raw then phi then L2; S_PRE applies phi to valid raw before pooling with no token L2; MV normalizes region tokens and final anchor-plus-residual
permutation: External joint valid-token permutation; FG2_GROUP_CONTROL_V1 / key / condition / frame / salt9173; SHA256 first8 big endian; NumPy default_rng; prefix consistent
residual: FG variants use parent correct(base, group_vectors-base, alpha, eta); MV uses unit(base+eta*output_projection(pooled)); static means have no learned residual
